name: Case law: United States Tax Court (DAWSON)
label: United States case law (the United States Tax Court)
coverage: 13888 decisions, one file and one commit each, dated the day filed: 340 T.C. opinions, 8,899 memorandum opinions (T.C. Memo.), 2,788 summary opinions, 1,861 bench opinions; 43456 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: each decision is added by one Kind: court commit; a Kind: correction commit (Corrects: the commit it corrects, Corrected: the day) later fixes a file's text or details, dated with the same In-force day, and is credited only with the lines it changed. In-force is the day the opinion was filed. From the Court's own case system, DAWSON. T.C. opinions in volumes 1-144 are in united-states/federal-special/caselaw (Caselaw Access Project) and are left out here; 4 decisions here share a docket and year with a decision there and are listed in decision-relations.tsv as same-decision-as.
update: none yet: rebuilt by hand from DAWSON

overlay.reader: tools/usc_cite.py: a page stamp ("USCA4") is no citation, "(a)(4)" a subsection, a range ("§§ 101-1330", "§§ 1 through 16") links neither end (its ends are no more cited than the sections between them); a citation under an older numbering (before the title was recodified, before the section was added, an earlier edition, "former") is not linked; one row per decision (decision-relations.tsv duplicates left out)
